i.norm: Verifies that translating Integer.MAX_VALUE (0x7FFFFFFF) as a Unicode code point produces a supplementary-plane escape sequence "翿FFFF" and returns true, since the default UnicodeEscaper covers all code points [0, Integer.MAX_VALUE].
The default UnicodeEscaper escapes every code point in [0, Integer.MAX_VALUE]
Integer.MAX_VALUE (0x7FFFFFFF) exceeds the BMP range (> 0xFFFF), so translate() delegates to toUtf16Escape(), producing "\\u7FFFFFFF"
